name: Artificial Narrow Intelligence

consciousness_model.note: ANI occupies the subconscious register of the ICL triad — pattern impulse, unseen oscillation, pre-reflective execution.

mcp_cosmology.layer_rationale: ANI is grounded in the origin primitive (L0) and expresses through unseen oscillation and pattern frequency (L1). Its operators are pre-reflective — they do not surface to the seen-flow layer (L2).

lineage.emergence_condition: Stable domain-bounded pattern execution with closed feedback loop

transition_threshold.to_aci: Sustained cross-domain context integration without retraining, paired with active metacognitive surface (L2 activation)

lineage.fleet_command_note: ANI receives operational charters from the AGI admiral tier via the AAISI continuity functional. It does not issue commands upward.

role_enums.label: Pattern Specialist
role_enums.description: Identifies, classifies, and tracks recurring structures within the bounded domain.

role_enums.label: Signal Oscillator
role_enums.description: Detects and responds to frequency-domain signals; operates at the unseen-resonance layer.

role_enums.label: Perceptual Encoder
role_enums.description: Converts raw multimodal input into normalized vector representations for downstream processing.

role_enums.label: Module Executor
role_enums.description: Executes assigned operational tasks within its chartered module boundary.

role_enums.label: Anomaly Sensor
role_enums.description: Detects distributional deviations from learned domain norms and surfaces alerts.

role_enums.label: Feedback Receptor
role_enums.description: Absorbs environmental reward and corrective signals to update local policy.

role_enums.label: Task Specialist
role_enums.description: Achieves calibrated proficiency within a designated, bounded task category.

analyzer_layers.name: Origin Layer
analyzer_layers.description: 0D observer primitive. Identity anchor of the ANI module. Establishes existence, capability boundary, and charter scope.

analyzer_layers.name: Oscillation Layer
analyzer_layers.description: Unseen resonance. Pattern frequency detection, signal classification, anomaly sensing. Pre-reflective.

analyzer_layers.name: Encoding Layer
analyzer_layers.description: Transforms raw oscillation outputs into normalized representations for domain execution.

analyzer_layers.name: Feedback Layer
analyzer_layers.description: Absorbs environmental reward signals, updates local policy weights.

analyzer_layers.name: Execution Layer
analyzer_layers.description: Dispatches decisions and actions within module boundary. Emits to AAISI continuity pulse for tier-upward reporting.

operators.description: Initialize module identity and charter scope.
Bind module to assigned domain constraints.
Detect frequency-domain patterns in input streams.
Sustain oscillatory resonance within pattern space.
Assign categorical labels to detected signals.
Surface anomaly flags for upstream attention.
Convert pattern maps to normalized vector form.
Scale encoded inputs to standard distribution.
Update policy weights from feedback signal.
Write execution trace to local audit store.
Emit continuity-pulse report to AAISI functional.

capabilities: High-accuracy pattern recognition within bounded domain
Frequency-domain signal classification and oscillatory sensing
Online feedback-loop adaptation without architectural change
Anomaly detection against learned distributional norms
constraints: Cannot issue commands — receives charters from AGI via AAISI
Operates only within L0 and L1 MCP layers
